**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target) on § 3.4 (p0022).**

- **Only responsive clause:** § 3.4 is the sole inspection right binding the Company; no other audit/verification or system-access provision exists (§ 1.4 access runs in our favour, and the § 5.4 General Manager provisions create no inspection right).
- **Already met:** 30 days' prior written notice (above the 15-day floor) and HDI bearing all inspection fees unconditionally (better than a 10% underpayment shift); business hours also limited.
- **Failure:** no frequency cap at all — unlimited inspections fail the fallback and approach walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** one surgical insertion of "no more than once in any twelve (12) month period", preserving all favourable notice, business-hours and cost language verbatim; no upgrade to preferred wording and no volunteered underpayment cost-shift.
